answer: Proof-of-stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator identity is tethered to verifiable capital rather than a virtual island of disposable nodes. By requiring a comet of locked assets to participate, the network ensures that each identity carries a tangible cost of capital. Any echo of a fake identity attempt becomes economically irrational, as an attacker must expend significant resources to replicate stake, making the systemic cost of subversion prohibitive for malicious agents.
